```{r }
#| fig-cap: Spatial mixing matrix by sexual orientation
#| label: fig-sexorientation-mixing-matrix
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6


targets::tar_read(plotdata_sexorientation_mixing_matrix) |>
  dplyr::filter(ego_level != "Something Else", alter_level != "Something Else") |> 
  plot_matrix_mixing() +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc_gradient("Spatial mixing coefficient", labels = scales::label_percent(), breaks = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-0.5,  1.2)) +
  scale_color_mpxnyc_gradient() +
  ggplot2::scale_alpha_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_mpxnyc_mixing() 

```
